result_id.description: Momondo-assigned unique identifier for this flight result; use for deduplication.

origin.description: Departure airport object with code and name.

destination.description: Arrival airport object with code and name.

departure_time.description: Local departure time at origin airport (ISO 8601 format).

arrival_time.description: Local arrival time at destination airport (ISO 8601 format).

duration_minutes.description: Total trip duration in minutes (all legs combined).

stops.description: Number of stops (0 = nonstop). Derived from segment count minus 1 per leg.

legs.description: Per-leg details for the flight itinerary. One-way = 1 leg; round-trip = 2 legs; multi-city = N legs.

items.description: A single leg object containing origin, destination, times, duration, stops, and segments.

origin.description: Leg-level departure airport with code and name.

destination.description: Leg-level arrival airport with code and name.

departure_time.description: Local departure time for this leg (ISO 8601).

arrival_time.description: Local arrival time for this leg (ISO 8601).

stops.description: Number of stops within this leg.

segments.description: Individual flight segments within the leg.

items.description: A single flight segment with airline, flight number, aircraft, and times.

airline_code.description: 2-letter IATA carrier code (e.g., BA, AA, LH).

airline_name.description: Full airline display name (e.g., British Airways).

flight_number.description: Full flight number including carrier code (e.g., BA177).

departure_time.description: Local departure time for this segment (ISO 8601).

arrival_time.description: Local arrival time for this segment (ISO 8601).

booking_options.description: Available booking partners with prices and URLs.

items.description: A single booking option with provider, price, and booking URL.

provider_name.description: Display name of the booking partner.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

booking_url.description: Direct deep link to the booking partner page.

cabin_class.description: Cabin class for this booking option (e.g., Economy, Business).

scraped_at.description: UTC timestamp when this result was collected (ISO 8601 format).
